name: recipe-search
description: One search box across the recipe sites Kyle trusts, from our own small index. Live at findish.now.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-index.mjs && node scripts/stage-explore.mjs && astro dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build-index.mjs && node scripts/stage-explore.mjs && astro build
scripts.test: node --test crawler/test/*.test.mjs src/lib/*.test.mjs src/mcp/*.test.mjs src/chat/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
